text:
Omar (Sales): quick heads-up — Ambassador Health POC kicks off Monday. Need to lock the eval handoff: success criteria, golden prompts, who owns labeling, and any enterprise blockers (security questionnaire + pricing). Can we sync today?

Tariq (SE): yup. primary use case is clinical note summarization + triage routing. Do they want verbatim summary or structured extract? that changes metrics. also: what's target throughput?

Omar (Sales): customer wants short clinical summaries (2-3 bullet points) + a triage tag (low/med/high). throughput ~100 req/s peak for demo, lower steady. security team will send their questionnaire later today.

Lenka (ML-Research): for summarization I recommend: golden seed ~200 examples (edge cases + typical), regression set ~1k randomly sampled. scoring: composite metric = 0.6 * ROUGE-L + 0.3 * clinical-entity-F1 + 0.1 * hallucination-penalty. set acceptance at composite >= 0.75 for the pilot.

Tariq (SE): agree. also add an exact-match for triage tag (accuracy) with threshold >= 0.9. keep p95 latency target <= 200ms on our hosted tier for demo.

Elaine (Platform): we can wire the eval harness to CI and gate merges. I pushed a harness stub — deploy-bot: harness/v1 created. config suggestion:
```
- seed_set: s3://redwood-demo/ambassador/seed.jsonl
- regression_set: s3://redwood-demo/ambassador/reg.jsonl
- scoring_script: infra/evals/ambassador_score.py
- gate: composite >= 0.75 AND triage_acc >= 0.9
```
I can attach a GH Actions workflow to run on PR.

deploy-bot: harness/v1 deployed to staging (logs: /var/log/harness/195246).

Omar (Sales): pricing question from AE: if we need Dedicated GPUs for the 2-week POC burst, what's ballpark (including short-term autoscale)? they also asked about data retention for logs (security).

Elaine (Platform): rough POC estimate: 1 x A10G-equivalent pool reserved during business hours ~ $1,200/day, spike autoscale (on-demand) add ~ $300/day. can convert to a commit if they want lower rates. logs: we can set retention per-customer (default 30d), can extend to 180d on request.

Tariq (SE): acceptance gates recap:
- composite score >= 0.75 on regression set
- triage tag accuracy >= 0.9
- p95 latency <= 200ms on hosted or dedicated baseline
- no increase >5% in hallucination rate vs seed baseline
- stable for 48h under demo load
If any gate fails, auto-fallback to smaller model variant and flag for human review.

Lenka (ML-Research): labeling notes: we should aim for 2 annotators per example, resolve ties with a senior annotator. target inter-annotator agreement Cohen's kappa >= 0.7. we can supply UI + quick guidelines and do initial calibration with 50 examples. who will annotate? customer or Redwood?

Omar (Sales): I'll ask Ambassador product if they want to label. add that as a checklist item for kickoff. also looping in security and AE after call. can someone share the harness README link?

Elaine (Platform): README: https://internal.redwood.ai/harnesss/ambassador (draft). I'll add the GH workflow and the pricing note.

Tariq (SE): I'll draft the scoring script and seed prompt examples. one sample prompt for the seed set: 

"Patient with HTN and cough for 3 days. Summary and triage: "

Lenka (ML-Research): thanks — I'll prepare the 200 seed examples and upload to the s3 path above. planning to include 30 edge cases (negations, multi-condition).

Omar (Sales): perfect. next steps: 1) security questionnaire response (Omar to own), 2) labeling decision (Ambassador), 3) harness setup + CI (Elaine + Tariq), 4) golden seed upload (Lenka). Sync check-in Friday 10am PT. :thumbsup:
